**Company Description**
**AfterQuery**
is a research lab investigating the boundaries of artificial intelligence through novel datasets and experimentation. We're backed by top investors, including Y Combinator and Box Group, and support all leading AI labs.

BenchmarkAI publishes investment research and indexes. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok each run their own investment teams across 160 portfolios, and we publish what they decide and why. If we're successful, our business looks more like S&P Global than Bridgewater or BlackRock.

**Read this first:**
https://www.benchmarkai.app/about/investment-system. When you apply, tell us one thing in it you'd change or test next. That note tells us more than a resume.

You'll build and run the system behind the BenchmarkAI Indexes. Every day, 5 agents across 4 frontier models research the market. Every month, 160 portfolios research, decide and rebalance in about 40 hours. You'll make that faster, cheaper and harder to break.

**Pay:**
$150,000 to $250,000 a year, plus equity. Every full-time offer includes equity, unlimited paid time off, premium health insurance and quarterly offsites. Salary ranges run from the low end of a remote offer to the high end of a San Francisco one.

**Location:**
Remote in US time zones, or Miami, New York or San Francisco.

**Level:**
Mid-level. You've done this job before, and you still do the work yourself.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the runs.**
  Daily research and the monthly rebalance. Make every run finish, and know what it costs.
* **Build the deterministic layer.**
  The data, screens and tools the agents call. This code has to give the same answer every time.
* **Ship what people read.**
  The research pages, the index pages and the research plugin that brings our research into people's own AI assistants.
* **Direct the agents.**
  Agents write much of our code. You tell them what to build, review what they write and own what ships.

**What we're looking for**

* **You're an AI super user.**
  You build with coding agents every day and know where they fail.
* **You've shipped LLM systems to production.**
  Long-running jobs, structured outputs, evaluations and a bill you had to explain.
* **You've built production systems on real data.**
  Data that has to reconcile, every time.
* **You protect the record.**
  A published number or decision never changes after the fact. You build so it can't.

**What we're not looking for**

* **The rewriter.**
  Wants a new architecture before shipping the fix.
* **The ticket taker.**
  Waits for a spec. Here you write it.

More about the team and how we work: https://www.benchmarkai.app/careers

AfterQuery is looking for experts with experience in software engineering, computer science, or app/web development to help train and evaluate AI models. This is a remote, project-based role: qualify once through a single assessment and receive ongoing project matches spanning code review, evaluation, and original task creation. Pay ranges from $50 to $100/hour depending on the projects you qualify into.
  
  
**Why Apply**

* Competitive Pay: $50–$100/hour across the project pool
* One Assessment, Ongoing Matches: qualify once, get matched to projects continuously
* Flexible Engagement: fully remote and asynchronous, on your own schedule

**Responsibilities**

* Complete software engineering tasks across a range of AI training and evaluation projects
* Review and evaluate code and model outputs for correctness and quality
* Deliver clear, well-documented work independently

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of real-world software engineering experience (full-time or substantive internships count)
* Strong fundamentals in at least one major programming language
* Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently
